units.source_text: 他趁着一个人睡觉的时机，想把腰带挂在窗棂子上上吊自杀。

en.t: Taking the chance when he was sleeping alone, he tried to hang his belt from the window lattice and kill himself.

units.source_text: 可是当他把脖子套进腰带时突然恐惧死亡。

en.t: But when he slipped his neck into the belt, he suddenly became afraid of death.

units.source_text: 并不是害怕死的那刹那所带来的痛苦。

en.t: It was not the pain that would come at the instant of death that he feared.

units.source_text: 他第二次自杀时拿着怀表想要测试缢死的时间。

en.t: When he attempted suicide a second time, he held a pocket watch and tried to measure the time it took to die by hanging.

units.source_text: 稍微感觉到些许痛苦的时候，神志就开始模糊了。

en.t: As soon as he felt even a little pain, his consciousness began to grow hazy.

units.source_text: 只要坚持过了这段时间，一定能实现死的目的。

en.t: If he could only endure past that stretch of time, he would surely achieve his aim of dying.

units.source_text: 他看了一眼怀抱的指针，发现痛苦的过程时间约莫一分二十几秒。

en.t: He glanced at the hands of the watch in his breast pocket and found that the period of pain lasted roughly one minute and twenty-odd seconds.
Outside the window lattice, it was pitch dark.

units.source_text: 漆黑之中传来了粗犷的鸡鸣声。

en.t: From within the pitch darkness came the rough cry of a rooster.
